segments.ja369:1.1: Kyāhaṃ devānamakaraṃ, kiṃ pāpaṃ pakataṃ mayā;
segments.ja369:1.3: Yaṃ me sirasmiṃ ohacca [uhacca (ka.), uhacca (pī.)], cakkaṃ bhamati matthake.
segments.ja369:3.1: Ito bahutarā bhogā, atra maññe bhavissare;
segments.ja369:3.3: Iti etāya saññāya, passa maṃ byasanaṃ gataṃ.
segments.ja369:4.1: Catubbhi aṭṭhajjhagamā, aṭṭhāhipi ca [aṭṭhāhi cāpi (sī. syā.), aṭṭhābhi cāpi (ka.)] soḷasa;
segments.ja369:5.1: Uparivisālā duppūrā, icchā visaṭagāminī [upari visālaṃ duppūraṃ, icchāvisadagāminī (sī.)];
segments.ja369:5.3: Ye ca taṃ anugijjhanti, te honti cakkadhārinoti.
